item.title: Third water line commissioned at Sheikhupura
item.description: We have commissioned a third drinking-water bottling line at the Sheikhupura plant, taking water capacity from 38,000 to 60,000 bottles a day.

item.title: Mango intake for 2026 closes 12% above last season
item.description: This year’s mango pulp intake closed at 12% above the 2025 season, despite a start delayed by roughly two weeks in the Rahim Yar Khan belt.

item.title: ISO 22000 recertified through 2028
item.description: The Sheikhupura plant has been recertified to ISO 22000:2018 following a three-day audit in April, with the certificate now valid through August 2028.
